key_facts.interpretation: 405 = path /user/{userId}/time-entries/{id}/duplicate IS registered. GET not allowed. POST is the correct method. The fake entry ID did not cause a 'No static resource' 404 — routing succeeded to the path handler which rejected the method.

prior_truth_yaml_suspicion.note: TRUTH.yaml iter20 flagged strong suspicion of absence: /user/{userId}/time-entries/stop was confirmed ABSENT. However, this probe contradicts that suspicion.
prior_truth_yaml_suspicion.result: 405 confirms path IS registered. The /stop sub-path was absent but /duplicate is present.

supporting_evidence.note: GET /workspaces/{wId}/user/{userId}/time-entries (no ID, no /duplicate suffix) returns 200 with real time entries, confirming the /user/{userId}/time-entries path family is live.

promotion_evidence: GET /user/{userId}/time-entries/FAKE_ID/duplicate returned 405 'Request method GET is not supported'. Per probe protocol: 405 = path registered. The TRUTH.yaml suspicion of absence was based on the /stop sibling being absent — this probe directly refutes that suspicion with live evidence. Additionally, GET /user/{userId}/time-entries (parent path) returns 200 with real data confirming the path family. Promoting from UNCONFIRMED-AGREE to LIVE-VERIFIED.
notes: TRUTH.yaml iter20 note said 'strong suspicion of absence' because /stop was absent — however /duplicate does not follow the same pattern. 405 is clear evidence. The path uses singular /user/ (confirmed live by parent GET returning 200). POST response shape unconfirmed (raw writes blocked).
